sloka: अधारयद्यो विविधाश्चित्रा: सुमनसस्तदा सोऽयं जटाभारमिमं वहते राघव: कथम् ॥ २.९९.३३॥
transliteration: adhārayadyo vividhāścitrā: sumanasastadā so'yaṁ jaṭābhāramimaṁ vahate rāghava: katham ॥ 2.99.33॥

translations.english: How is it that Rama who used to wear variegated flowers formerly, now bears these heavy matted locks?
